question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a silver ball, Eve has a red ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Fred swap balls. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) pink ball
(C) grey ball
(D) silver ball
(E) red ball
(F) gold ball
(G) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (yellow, pink, grey, silver, red, gold, orange)
1. Fred ↔ Bob: (yellow, gold, grey, silver, red, pink, orange)
2. Gertrude ↔ Bob: (yellow, orange, grey, silver, red, pink, gold)
3. Gertrude ↔ Bob: (yellow, gold, grey, silver, red, pink, orange)
4. Eve ↔ Dave: (yellow, gold, grey, red, silver, pink, orange)
5. Fred ↔ Claire: (yellow, gold, pink, red, silver, grey, orange)
6. Dave ↔ Fred: (yellow, gold, pink, grey, silver, red, orange)
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: (yellow, gold, pink, orange, silver, red, grey)
Gertrude has the grey ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
